text: How does a bank install this system on its own servers, with no setting left at a default and no secret typed into a file?
prefix: How does a bank install this system on its own servers, with no setting left at a default and no secret typed into a file?

text: The system ships as two units, installed separately: the cards unit first, because it is the card zone, then ecom, which only calls it.
prefix: The system ships as two units, installed separately: the cards unit first, because it is the card zone, then ecom, which only calls it.

text: Each unit is one Docker Compose install with its own Vault, Postgres, Keycloak and monitoring; the Kubernetes manifests are parked, and Compose is the reference install.
prefix: Each unit is one Docker Compose install with its own Vault, Postgres, Keycloak and monitoring; the Kubernetes manifests are parked, and Compose is the reference install.

text: Every setting lives in Vault: each service's settings are rendered into environment variables, and the services read only those.
prefix: Every setting lives in Vault: each service's settings are rendered into environment variables, and the services read only those.

text: Nothing has a default: a missing value stops startup, and the error names it.
prefix: Nothing has a default: a missing value stops startup, and the error names it.

text: Opening Vault stays human: it starts with five unseal shares, any three of them open it, and each share is held by a different person.
prefix: Opening Vault stays human: it starts with five unseal shares, any three of them open it, and each share is held by a different person.

text: The root token is used only for setup and then revoked; any later change needs three keyholders again.
prefix: The root token is used only for setup and then revoked; any later change needs three keyholders again.

text: Everything else is code: OpenTofu creates Vault's setup and every service's settings, and generates every password, key and certificate, with its own state encrypted by a passphrase.
prefix: Everything else is code: OpenTofu creates Vault's setup and every service's settings, and generates every password, key and certificate, with its own state encrypted by a passphrase.

text: One procedure runs on a laptop, a dev server and production; only what the environment alone knows is typed in, once, and OpenTofu names any value that is missing or malformed.
prefix: One procedure runs on a laptop, a dev server and production; only what the environment alone knows is typed in, once, and OpenTofu names any value that is missing or malformed.

text: The first bank admins come from one input, at least two of them, so nobody holds the bank side alone; each sets their own password and authenticator app.
prefix: The first bank admins come from one input, at least two of them, so nobody holds the bank side alone; each sets their own password and authenticator app.

text: A release is a tag: its images are pinned to that version, built for x86 and ARM, each with a bill of materials and build provenance.
prefix: A release is a tag: its images are pinned to that version, built for x86 and ARM, each with a bill of materials and build provenance.

text: There is no deploy repository of ours: which version runs where is the bank's state, in its own Git, under its own change control.
prefix: There is no deploy repository of ours: which version runs where is the bank's state, in its own Git, under its own change control.

text: The card zone is the bank's vault room, with walls, guards, cameras and patching; the product is the safe delivered into it.
prefix: The card zone is the bank's vault room, with walls, guards, cameras and patching; the product is the safe delivered into it.

text: So each unit ships an implementation guide: what the zone must provide, how to install and run the product, and a P C I D S S matrix of what the product does and what the bank does.
prefix: So each unit ships an implementation guide: what the zone must provide, how to install and run the product, and a P C I D S S matrix of what the product does and what the bank does.

text: Next: the cards unit, its two doors and its certificates.
prefix: Next: the cards unit, its two doors and its certificates.
